name: pipefish-labs-mcp-server
description: Enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the PipeFish Labs autonomous multi-agent mesh. Supports 22 scenario graphs, Native Mistral Handoffs, zero-trust Vault leases, eBPF kernel telemetry, and NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 post-quantum cryptographic verification.

tools.name: trigger_agent_graph
tools.description: Trigger an 8-node autonomous agent graph execution with Native Mistral Handoffs and Zero-Data Retention.

tools.name: get_agent_spec
tools.description: Inspect detailed architecture, MCP connectors, RBAC permissions, and PQC cryptographic handoff specs for an agent.

tools.name: verify_enclave_status
tools.description: Verify Zero-Data Retention (ZDR) confidential enclave integrity and NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 encryption readiness.

tools.name: k8s_autoscale_check
tools.description: Check Kubernetes pod resource metrics and evaluate Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) scaling recommendations.

tools.name: vault_lease_issue
tools.description: Issue an ephemeral dynamic secret lease with automated revocation upon DAG task completion.

tools.name: ebpf_kernel_profile
tools.description: Profile eBPF kernel tracepoints to identify RPC serialization bottlenecks and latency anomalies.

tools.name: db_zdr_query
tools.description: Execute a Zero-Data Retention (ZDR) database read with automated PII masking and RAM-only logging.
